    l = np.array(list(l))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if l.size == 0:
        return ax
        
    mu, std = stats.norm.fit(l)
    
    # Plot the histogram.
    ax.hist(l, bins='auto', density=True, alpha=0.7)
    
    # Plot the Gaussian PDF fit.
    xmin, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
    x = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, 100)
    p = stats.norm.pdf(x, mu, std)
    ax.plot(x, p, linewidth=2)
    
    # Set the title with exactly two spaces after the comma, as specified.
    ax.set_title(f"Fit results: mu = {mu:.2f},  std = {std:.2f}")
